name: Drake Ridion
source:
Sign: Leo

Profile: Talented method actor who can play sexy pirate dukes and stoic assassins

Likes: Complex roles, collecting wine & jewelry, reptiles, flashy scarves

Dislikes: Bad interview questions, being told by his agent that he sucks at fashion

Style: Boho casual, tailored suits, vintage prints

"You can't just order me around like this, you know. Every other stylist would've answered my call and immediately offered to straighten my collar."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nochistudios/zipup]Kickstarter[/url]]
